name: Degree assortativity
formula: corr(k_source(u),k_target(v)) over arcs; each undirected edge appears in both orientations.
source_version: NetworkX 3.5 definitions/reference algorithms; MATLAB R2024b numerical kernels; cited paper publication version
license: Original formula/algorithm implementation; no third-party code copied. Inspected NetworkX 3.5 is BSD-3-Clause; MATLAB runtime uses its own license.
conditions: No-edge or constant endpoint degree: undefined; directed in-in/in-out/out-in/out-out use explicit parameters.

name: Average neighbor degree
definition: Distinct-neighbor mean degree; all mode counts a reciprocated neighbor once.
formula: k_nn(i)=sum_{j in selected distinct neighbors(i)} k_target(j) / |neighbors(i)|.
source_version: NetworkX 3.5 definitions/reference algorithms; MATLAB R2024b numerical kernels; cited paper publication version
license: Original formula/algorithm implementation; no third-party code copied. Inspected NetworkX 3.5 is BSD-3-Clause; MATLAB runtime uses its own license.
conditions: neighbor_mode=in/out/all (all is distinct union); target_degree=in/out/total. Undirected choices reduce to degree. No selected neighbor: invalid NaN.

name: Greedy modularity communities
definition: Dense exact delta-Q agglomeration; original implementation of the greedy modularity principle, not the NetworkX heap implementation.
formula: Start singleton partition; repeatedly merge the pair with maximum delta Q>gain_tolerance.

license: Original formula/algorithm implementation; no third-party code copied. Inspected NetworkX 3.5 is BSD-3-Clause; MATLAB runtime uses its own license.
conditions: Deterministic tie break by smallest representative original node IDs; labels are representative IDs; no global optimum guarantee; M=0 undefined; max_nodes refusal explicit.
